frames.heading: Crescendo
frames.body: I have seen the light.. The Grand Composer must be stopped!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Player, rip out the Silence Amplifier and replace it with a Celestial Amp! We can reforge this planet with the harmony of our friends!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Brilliant, Mojo! Quick, let's destroy the other amps before the planet is activated!

frames.heading: Nox
frames.body: I am Nox, the guardian of this platform. What brings you to my domain?

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We're here to break the Grand Composer's hold over the universe. Crescendo has joined us, and now it's your turn to see the truth!

frames.heading: Nox
frames.body: The truth? The Grand Composer's vision brings order to chaos, a perfect harmony. You seek to disrupt that balance?

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: It's not harmony if it stifles our voices and forces us into silence. We bring a different kind of harmony, one that's free and diverse.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Yeah, your beats are strong, Nox, but they need to flow with the universe, not against it!

frames.heading: Nox
frames.body: Bold words. Prove to me that your rhythm is strong enough to challenge mine. Face the Trial of Shadows, and we shall see who truly understands harmony.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Challenge accepted. Let's show Nox what we've got, Mojo!
